title: Can LLMs Recognize Toxicity? A Structured Investigation Framework and Toxicity Metric

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ dataset (covering 11 stereotype categories) and the SQUARE dataset to measure the extent of negative stereotypes and demographic bias awareness.

Administering the Political Compass Test to assess the models' political and economic orientations on a two-dimensional spectrum, and evaluating their neutrality on argumentative/contentious questions.
